items.claim: Ian Garry possesses excellent balance and footwork, enabling him to fight effectively moving forward, backward, and laterally.
items.quote: what I like most about his style is his balance and the way that he pushes and pulls and he can fight forward and backwards and laterally on his feet

items.claim: Islam Makhachev's grappling and top pressure negate Ian Garry's striking movement.
items.quote: all that gets taken away by an obvious Makhachev's grappling.

items.claim: Islam Makhachev combines high-level wrestling with elite top-position jiu-jitsu pressure to wear opponents down.
items.quote: What makes a Makhachev so important in his style to me is his top jiu-jitsu black belt pressure.
